description:
List workspace email summaries, newest first.

        Summaries contain IDs and metadata, without message bodies.
        Returns ``items`` and ``next_cursor``, or an error.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

direction.description: Only mail received by the workspace (``inbound``) or only mail it sent (``outbound``). Omitted: both.
direction.title: Direction

status.description: Only emails currently in this status; ``received`` means inbound. Omitted: every status.
status.title: Status

name: list_emails
title: List emails
